description: Clay provides a public API that requires an API key in the request header, allowing developers to integrate its services into applications.

evidence.claim: Clay API authentication requires a Clay API key provided in the "clay-api-key" header
API keys can be created by users under Settings → Account → API keys (beta)
Developers can call the Clay Public API from their own applications and services such as backend jobs and internal tools
The Clay Public API is accessed via HTTP endpoints (e.g., https://api.clay.com/public/v0/me) using standard REST conventions
